outcomeNote: Two parallel homiletic readings of the lemma; no argument between them is developed.

segments.he: ״וַיְנַצְּלוּ אֶת מִצְרָיִם״. אָמַר רַבִּי אַמֵּי מְלַמֵּד שֶׁעֲשָׂאוּהָ כִּמְצוּדָה שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ דָּגָן, וְרֵישׁ לָקִישׁ אָמַר, עֲשָׂאוּהָ כִּמְצוּלָה שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ דָּגִים.
segments.en: With regard to the continuation of the verse: «And they emptied Egypt, Rabbi Ami said:» This indicates that «they made» Egypt «like a trap in which there is no grain» that serves as bait to attract birds. «Reish Lakish said: They made» Egypt «like an abyss» in the sea «without fish.»

moves.summary: Lemma: the continuation of Exodus 12:36, 'and they emptied Egypt'.
moves.about: the lemma 'and they emptied Egypt' (Exodus 12:36) opens the exposition

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי אמי מלמד שעשאוה כמצודה
moves.summary: R' Ami: they made Egypt like a trap with no grain left in it.
moves.about: 'they emptied Egypt' means they made it like a trap without grain

moves.summary: Reish Lakish (parallel exposition): they made Egypt like a sea-depth with no fish.
moves.about: 'they emptied Egypt' means they made it like a sea-depth without fish

edges.about: the lemma 'and they emptied Egypt' (Exodus 12:36) opens the exposition
